args.command: echo '=== CHATGPT ==='; systemctl is-active zen-chatgpt-desktop.service 2>&1 || true; systemctl is-enabled zen-chatgpt-desktop.service 2>&1 || true; pgrep -a -u zenui -f '/usr/lib/chatgpt/ChatGPT|/usr/bin/chatgpt' || true; echo '=== TASKBAR/MONITOR ==='; systemctl is-active zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>&1 || true; systemctl is-enabled zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>&1 || true; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-pager | grep -Ei 'zen.*(mon|room|dash|display|chatgpt|taskbar)' || true; echo '=== XORG/VT ==='; pgrep -a -f '/usr/lib/xorg/Xorg :0|/usr/bin/Xorg :0' || true; fgconsole 2>&1 || true; echo '=== DRM ==='; for s in /sys/class/drm/card*-*/status; do [ -f "$s" ] && printf '%s=' "$s" && cat "$s"; done; echo '=== DPMS/XRANDR ==='; runuser -u zenui -- env HOME=/var/lib/zenui DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/var/lib/zenui/.Xauthority xset q 2>&1 | grep -A4 -Ei 'DPMS|Monitor' || true; runuser -u zenui -- env HOME=/var/lib/zenui DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/var/lib/zenui/.Xauthority xrandr --query 2>&1 || true

meta.summary: Diagnose GPT and monitor/dashboard visibility after display power cycle
